#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
Cyclopts CLI with pyproject.toml configuration support.
"""

import cyclopts
from pathlib import Path

# Create sample pyproject.toml if it doesn't exist
Path("pyproject.toml").write_text("""[tool.mycli]
name = "Alice"
greeting = "Hello"
count = 2
""", exist_ok=True)

# Create app with built-in TOML config file support
app = cyclopts.App(
    config_search_paths=["pyproject.toml"],
    default_config_key="tool.mycli"
)

@app.default
def main(
    name: str = "World",
    greeting: str = "Hi",
    count: int = 1,
):
    """
    Greet someone multiple times.
    
    Defaults load from [tool.mycli] in pyproject.toml.
    Command-line arguments override config file values.
    """
    for _ in range(count):
        print(f"{greeting}, {name}!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    app()
